_subject.notes: Rear plate, rear tailgate badge, front plate. Side badges not cut.

plate.notes: Rear number plate 'BYD ATTO 3 / 2026', 566x168, cut from the press render. Template match finds it (score ~0.77 on H3 1080p rear renders). Mid preset (area prescale 1.2, unsharp 0.35, black-level match, blur 0.5) chosen on the Atto 3 turntable 2026-09-19: levels match + blur 1.2 read grey and soft, prescale 1.5 / unsharp 0.8 too crisp against H3 footage.

badge.notes: Chrome 'ATTO 3' tailgate lettering, 565x120 with letters-only alpha. Gray template match locks onto the wrong thing; edges mode or a key_box of the whole artwork rectangle.
